method.workload: 49 inventory stones; frozen nine-stone and empty stacks, 512 iterations. Search time excludes setup/teardown.
method.execution: Sequential isolated benchmark processes, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; same CUDA hardware.
method.replay: First actual MCTS batch of each short/long simulation stage, 3 warm repeats. Timings exclude capture/setup/hashing. Input/output hash coverage is recorded in each replay.
method.controls: Completion checks 16/32/64 without graphs; reuse32 adds only buffers; graph32/64 add phase-local timestep graphs. All replay inputs and output digests match the original baseline.
method.sweep: Change native capacity first at evaluation128/placement32; then placement64; then evaluation64/256 at the best native/chunk setting.
method.metrics: Evaluated throughput includes failed candidates. Nonfailed rate and distinct parents with children are reported separately. Changing evaluation batch alters the search allocation; higher throughput does not establish better decisions.
method.limitations: Individual full-search timings are noisy. Multiple seeds/states validate generalization but are not a statistical quality study. CUDA wrapper phase times include native host and result work. CPU profile uses different root/evaluation allocation.
method.trace: Baseline Nsight CUDA API duration includes device backpressure; do not interpret launch/copy API totals as pure overhead or transfer time.
method.empty_stack_gain: 3.4%, 3.9%, 4.4% across seeds 0,1,2; same ordered tree per seed.

replay-baseline.note: Captured real MCTS inputs, then repeated sequential native calls. Capture warms the workspace. Hashing and capture excluded from replay times. Input digest covers scenes/phases; resolved physics comes from the supplied app config. Output digest covers snapshots, samples and phase metrics; no CPU numerical equivalence claim.
